# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Tells Seth of Paradise

---

**14:1** 'When God made me from the dust of the earth and breathed into me the breath of life, he led me into paradise and showed me all the fruit of the trees.'

**14:2** 'And God commanded me and Eve to eat freely of all the fruits, but not to eat of one tree that was in the midst of paradise, which was the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.'

**14:3** 'And God commanded that the angels serve me and worship me in the sight of God.'

**14:4** 'And with that command, all the angels worshiped me, all except the devil. And for this reason he was cast out of heaven, and he set his malice against me.'

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
